references.label: Top A and B switches
references.description: The two upper letter switches that open the right gate and light the jet bumpers for increased value when completed.

references.label: Left and right eject pockets
references.description: The side pockets that stop the moving wheel and score its selected value.

references.label: Lower Wheel Value rollovers
references.description: The two lower rollovers that stop the moving wheel.

references.label: 10 Times Value lamp
references.description: The center feature lit when the stopped wheel number matches the active color.

references.label: Upper-right return gate
references.description: The gate opened by completing A and B.
